i.norm:
Verifies that evaluating the Sigmoid for a very large negative input drives the result to the lower asymptote of the configured curve.

A {@link Sigmoid} is bounded below by {@code lo} and above by {@code hi}. For a strongly negative argument the standard logistic curve saturates at its lower bound, so {@code value(x)} is expected to equal {@code lo}.
A DerivativeStructure with 620 free parameters, derivation order 0, holding a large negative value. Order 0 means only the function value (no derivatives) is tracked.
